# SalaryCityGuide
# Real Salaries — By City & Job Title
# https://salarycityguide.com

## About
SalaryCityGuide provides BLS-adjusted salary benchmarks for 15 professions across 161 US cities. Data reflects real compensation ranges adjusted for local cost of living using Bureau of Labor Statistics data.

## Data Type
salary data, compensation benchmarks, profession salary by city

## Coverage
161 US cities including: New York, NY, Los Angeles, CA, Chicago, IL, Houston, TX, Phoenix, AZ, Philadelphia, PA, San Antonio, TX, San Diego, CA and 153 more.

## Update Frequency
Quarterly — last updated March 2026

## Methodology
All cost estimates are calculated using Bureau of Labor Statistics Regional Price Parity indices applied to national baseline data from verified industry sources. Full methodology: https://salarycityguide.com/methodology
